Strata uses libheif-js 1.23.5 for optional, on-device HEIC still-image decoding.
The game first uses the browser's image decoder. If it cannot open a HEIF
photograph, the game loads the unmodified WebAssembly/JavaScript bundle in a
dedicated worker. The game disposes of the worker after that photograph.

libheif-bundle.js is the unmodified libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js file from
the libheif-js 1.23.5 npm distribution. SHA-256:
074b2b55ef3de477ba9f794ca381f3f0324c1cba8c91b4af07395f39c22d54cc

Copyright belongs to the upstream authors and contributors. The JS package is
licensed under LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE-package.txt). The WebAssembly build includes
libheif and libde265, which carry their own copyright and license notices.
LICENSE-libheif.txt and LICENSE-libde265.txt include the LGPL, GPL and the
upstream MIT notices for ancillary code. Original source-file notices are in
the source archive.

Corresponding source and build instructions

The accompanying corresponding-source.zip is available from this same directory:
https://jkubiniec.github.io/strata/vendor/heif/corresponding-source.zip

It contains the following four upstream source trees and their build recipes:
* libheif, commit 413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00
  https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00
* libde265 1.0.15, the upstream source tarball selected by build-emscripten.sh
  https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/releases/tag/v1.0.15
* libheif-emscripten v1.23.5, commit 5c8968a44e9c68ae677e24790d77d001ed7fe7cc
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-emscripten/tree/5c8968a44e9c68ae677e24790d77d001ed7fe7cc
* libheif-js 1.23.5, commit d8ec4bc3bc5bf8055975577bccbbc7e1d7313c2d
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js/tree/d8ec4bc3bc5bf8055975577bccbbc7e1d7313c2d

To rebuild, extract the four archives, populate the libheif-emscripten/libheif
submodule directory with the libheif tree, and follow its
.github/workflows/emscripten.yml WASM build with Emscripten 3.1.61. The
libheif/build-emscripten.sh script names its libde265 source tarball and build
options. Package the outputs as shown in the release job. In the libheif-js
tree, install its declared development dependencies, then run
node scripts/install.js /path/to/libheif.tar.gz to recreate the JS bundle.

Using a modified library

Replace vendor/heif/libheif-bundle.js in a local or hosted copy of Strata with
a compatible build. Reload the page. The worker loads the replacement from
this path, without any signature check or modification to the rest of the
game. You may modify the library and debug your modifications, including
reverse engineering for that purpose, under the applicable LGPL terms.
